notes: stocktaking adjustment out: types EFFECT 2,7 / TRNS_TYPE 7,40, lot balance checks, account per STACLNK; wave 3: soft delete, duplicate DOC_NO question, total, cost-centre limit / balance and reorder displays (APP_ACT_ST)

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a)) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_TRNS_DET.PEICE_NO.sql: (select max(i.peice_no) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_TRNS_DET.STORE_BALANCE.sql: round(nvl(get_balance_confg(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.item_confg_id, t.trns_date, t.date_serial, t.item_serial), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3)

ST_TRNS_DET.STORE_BALANCE_AFTER.sql: round(nvl(get_balance_confg(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.item_confg_id, t.trns_date, t.date_serial, t.item_serial), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3) - nvl(t.quantity, 0)

ST_TRNS_DET.STORE_COST.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_PASSWORD_NUMBER')), 0) = 0 or ((select nvl(max(b.show_cost), 0) from st_basic b) = 1 and (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_cost), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1)) then get_unit_cost_confg(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.item_confg_id, t.trns_date, t.date_serial, t.item_serial) * nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1) end

ST_TRNS_DET.REORDER_LIMIT.sql: (select max(i.reorder_limit) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_CONFG_ID.lov: select c.item_confg_id || ' - ' || c.lot_number || ' - ' || to_char(c.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, c.item_confg_id r from st_item_confg c where c.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE order by c.expire_date, c.item_confg_id

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE in (select t.trns_type_code from st_trns_type t where t.effect in (2, 7) and t.trns_type in (7, 40)) and nvl(DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or TRNS_TYPE_CODE in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))

validations.name: legacy header rules (type of the screen, CHECK_DATE, store, account, transfer, posted)
